hypothesis: H1 (world models): an agent that learned a world model of its home can keep acting when observation is removed — dead reckoning through the model, sharpened by a learned touch (bump) likelihood — but the same machinery fails in a stranger's home; and model-based Dyna dominates model-free Q-learning on sample efficiency.

config.budget_note: budget counts env steps only; Dyna planning is imagination; eval rollouts are budget-free and identical across conditions

tests.name: dyna_faster_than_q_t90
tests.metric: env steps to 90% eval success (censored -> budget+1)

conclusion.summary: Blindfolded dead reckoning through the home-learned model keeps working in HOME_A (success IQM: sighted 0.99, blind 0.21, blind+touch 0.96) but collapses in the stranger's HOME_B (blind 0.10 vs random floor 0.00); DynaQ reached 90% eval success by step 2000 (censored 0%) vs 24938 (censored 0%) for Q-learning.

trajectory_legend.bump: touch signal felt after the action; null on terminal row

blind-B at or near the random-A chance floor
